result.summary: Original BLOCKER genuinely resolved, independently re-verified against the actual current code (not the handoff's claim). Isolated fix commit c527888 read directly: insert_review/2 now wraps its attrs-build/insert pipeline in `with {:ok, tenant_id} <- TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(prefix) do ... end` and sets `tenant_id: tenant_id` -- the derived value -- never `plan.target_tenant_id`. Repo-wide grep for `target_tenant_id` in promotion_review_store.ex confirms exactly one hit, in the moduledoc prose describing the fix ('never read from args.plan.target_tenant_id') -- zero occurrences as a value assignment anywhere in the module. Confirmed tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:102-115) returns {:ok, canonical} | {:error, :invalid_schema_name}, matching insert_review_error()'s updated @type (:invalid_tenant_id dropped, :invalid_schema_name added, confirmed in source). The with-clause has no else branch, so {:error, :invalid_schema_name} short-circuits before Repo.insert is ever called -- confirmed by reading the control flow directly, not inferred. Scoping confirmed via `git show c527888`: touches only insert_review/2's body, its moduledoc doc comment, the insert_review_error @type, and one new alias (Letflow.TenantProvisioning) -- no other function in promotion_review_store.ex changed, and promotion.ex is untouched by this commit entirely (0 lines). `git diff origin/main...HEAD` for both files is the full new-file diff (both files are new on this branch, not yet merged), consistent with this being REQ-037's first landing. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`: exit 0, no output. Full INV-1..INV-8 checklist re-run from scratch (not just the delta): INV-1 APPLIES (tenant-scoped tables promotion_reviews/process_definitions) -- (a) every Repo call in both files carries an explicit prefix: opts[:prefix]/derived target_prefix/source_prefix, confirmed by reading every Repo.get/Repo.get_by/Repo.insert/Repo.update_all call site in both files, none use the default/public schema; (b) no migration in this diff (git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only lists no priv/repo/migrations/*.exs file -- promotion_reviews and process_definitions tables were created by prior requirements, out of this diff's scope); (c) tenant_id derivation now PASSES for insert_review/2 (the fix). promote_definition/3's write path (unchanged, re-verified since it depends on insert_review/2's output): target_tenant_id = review.tenant_id (now genuinely trustworthy since insert_review/2 derives it from opts[:prefix] rather than accepting it separately), target_prefix = TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant(target_tenant_id), and the new process_definitions row's tenant_id attr is set to that same target_tenant_id and written with prefix: target_prefix -- internally consistent, no independently-caller-supplied tenant_id at this write site. The chained cross-tenant-write consequence flagged in the original FAIL (a mismatched tenant_id from insert_review/2 propagating into promote_definition/3's target-schema write) no longer has a root cause since insert_review/2 no longer accepts an independent tenant_id. INV-1: PASS. INV-2/INV-3/INV-5: NOT-APPLICABLE (S4/S5 not started per security-invariants.md; no lookup-by-ID API endpoint added in this diff -- these are context-module functions, not API handlers). INV-4: APPLIES, PASS (grepped both files for System.get_env/password/secret/token: zero hits; no secret material touched). INV-6: this handoff is the proof-of-scoping artifact -- PASS on the strength of this review completing with an explicit per-invariant verdict. INV-7: APPLIES, PASS (grep -rn Repo.query lib/ priv/repo/migrations/ shows hits only in lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex, lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, lib/letflow/sandbox_pool/fixture_loader.ex -- none in this diff's two files, and none touched by this diff at all; both changed files use only Ecto.Query/Repo.insert/Repo.update_all, parameterized by construction).
